app_recommendations: Enforce a uniform 160°F (71.1°C) internal doneness standard for all pork Italian sausage dishes.
For stovetop skillet meals, instruct users to brown bulk sausage over medium-high heat without constant stirring to develop fond, followed by deglazing with white wine or broth.
For whole links, recommend gentle oven roasting (375°F for 1 hour, covered 20 mins then uncovered 40 mins) to prevent ruptured casings and ensure thoroughly cooked centers.
